notes.title: Version 10.0
notes.notes:
Added:
- Chinese troops
- Hungarian troops
- Romanian troops

notes.title: Version 9.0.0
notes.notes:
Version 9 now has a new squad order interface so you have more fine control over your units. You can get them to crawl to their destination by ordering 'sneak', you can set them to ambush, or completely hold their fire if you want. You can now also re-mount squads onto halftracks.

The summary of the update is:

- new squad orders user interface
- added 'Sneak', 'Ambush', 'Mount', 'Halt' and 'No Firing' commands
- blue line points from a unit's centre to its destination marker
- orange line points from a mortar squad's centre to its target
- new infantryman icon on the Custom game carousel now shows if a vehicle can mount a squad

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: - fixed a bug that could cause games to crash on some Windows computers

notes.title: Version 5.0
notes.notes:
- new building graphics
- added 14 new tank types, including M26 Pershing, M3 Lee/Grant, Flammpanzer III, and M8 Greyhound
- added the ability to drag bought squads in Custom battles to other slots
- vehicles can break down
- tanks now have separate gun mantlet armour

notes.title: Version 2.1
notes.notes: This is a big update to Firefight with everything under the hood tweaked and improved to make the gameplay even better!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
I've just uploaded the first update to Firefight. The big change is that at the end of a mission you get a summary dialog box appearing which lets you know your performance and you get a rating of how well you did from zero to three stars.

There are lots of other new features too like you can click on a radio message and the screen will jump to where that action occurred, the mouse cursor shows the height of the terrain underneath it, when you tell a squad to fire the mouse cursor shows the distance to the target and mortars show where they are currently doing a fire mission at.

There was also a bad bug which meant that enemy tanks and anti-tank guns sometimes could know where your tanks were if you tried sneaking around their flanks, and could turn to face you. It should be much easier now to sneak around the enemy and catch them unawares.
